items.title: Ford’s $30,000 EV Truck Sets Ambitious Goal: 100,000 Sales in Year One
items.summary: Ford Motor  is setting an ambitious target for its new electric truck that has only been seen by  Tesla  in the U.S.  The truck, called the Ford Fathom, starts around $30,000 and will go on sale next year.  Ford is seeking mainstream sales not seen by its earlier, more expensive electric vehicles.
